dct_description_sm: Data from a Biosonics DTX submersible with 120 kHz split-beam echosounder on a bottom-mounted frame in Grand Passage for 1 month. Nine days of data collected with the DTX before the battery pack (Oceansonics 72 D-cel Lithium) ran out of power.
Data collected from a Biosonics DTX Submersible scientific echosounder equipped with a 120 kHz split-beam transducer in Grand Passage NS Canada
